description: Store platform (Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, other store or not a store), catalog size, price range and store age for a domain, plus the tracking pixels and marketing tools on its homepage (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Pinterest, Klaviyo, Triple Whale and more). Results under a day old are reused; fresh checks are limited per day (10 without signing in, 50 signed in).

domain.description: The store's domain, e.g. brand.com. A URL works too.
